chunks: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: When the seed (nutfa) falls into the womb, it settles in it for forty days, and it becomes a clinging clot ('alaqa) for forty days, and it becomes a lump of flesh (mudgha) for forty days.

Then God sends two creating angels, and it is said to both of them: Create as God wills, male or female; form it, and write its appointed term, its sustenance, its death, and whether it is miserable or fortunate; and write for God the covenant which He took from it in the realm of particles, between its eyes.

So when its exit from the belly of its mother draws near, God sends to it an angel called Zajir (the Rebuker). He rebukes it with a rebuke, and it panics in great fright, and forgets the covenant, and falls to the ground crying from the rebuke of the angel.

key_terms.الخلاقان: Two creating angels charged with forming and recording the embryo's destiny
key_terms.الذر: Al-Dharr — the realm of particles, referring to the pre-worldly existence where souls were created
key_terms.العلقة: 'Alaqa — the clinging clot, second embryonic stage
key_terms.المضغة: Mudgha — the lump of flesh, third embryonic stage
key_terms.الميثاق: Mithaq — the primordial covenant by which all souls affirmed God's lordship
key_terms.النطفة: Nutfa — the seminal drop/sperm, the first embryonic stage
key_terms.زاجر: Zajir — 'the Rebuker,' the angel who startles the child at birth

ai.seo_question: What are the stages of human creation according to Imam al-Baqir in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) describes the stages of human embryonic development — nutfa, 'alaqa, and mudgha, each lasting forty days — followed by the dispatch of two angelic creators who form the embryo and record its destiny, including whether it will be blessed or wretched. Crucially, the angels also inscribe on the child the primordial covenant (mithaq) taken in the realm of particles (Alam al-Dharr), placing it between the child's eyes. At the moment of birth, the angel Zajir startles the child so violently that it forgets this covenant and enters the world weeping. This hadith speaks to classical Shia theology's integration of embryology, divine decree, and the Quranic covenant of Alam al-Dharr (Q. 7:172).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Zurara Bin Ayn who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When the seed falls into the womb, it vibrates in it for forty days, it settles in it for forty days, and becomes a cloth for forty days, and becomes a lump for forty days.

Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sends two creating Angels, so He<sup>azwj</sup> Says to both of them to create whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Intends, male or female. So they caricature it, and write down its term, and its sustenance, and its death, and whether it is to be miserable or fortunate, and they both write the Covenant for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> which He<sup>azwj</sup> had Taken from it in the (realm of the) particles, to be between its eyes.

So when it is near for its exit from the belly of its mother, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sends an Angel called Zajira (Rebuker) to it. So he rebukes it with a rebuke, so it panics and forgets the Covenant, and falls to the ground crying from the rebuking of the Angel’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Zurarah ibn ’ A‘yan who has said the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘When the seed falls in the womb it settles there for forty days, remains as a clot for forty days and as an embryo for another forty days.

Allah then sends two creative angels with instruction to create him, as Allah wants it to be. It can be a male or a female. They shape him and write down the duration of his life, the time of his death, that he is a fortunate or unfortunate. The two must write down between his eyes the covenant of Allah, which He has taken from him in the condition of being particles.

When the time for his coming out from the belly of his mother draws near; Allah sends an angel called admonisher who admonishes him that sends him into shock. He forgets the covenant and falls on the ground weeping because of the admonition of the angel?”
